results.claim: States Jun 2026 total revenue and that it fell versus May 2026 by about 6%.
results.evidence: States "Revenue 195,898 in Jun 2026: down 6.0% from May 2026 (208,351)"; the reference MoM is -5.98%, so 6.0% is within the policy.

results.claim: Puts the Jun 2026 revenue drop in context with at least one of: May 2026 was the highest month in the export; Jun 2026 is only about 0.5% below the prior 6-month average; Jun 2026 is about 2.8% above Jun 2025.
results.evidence: Says May 2026 "was the highest month in the export", "0.5% below the prior 6-month average" (true -0.532%) and "2.8% above Jun 2025" (true 2.80%).

results.claim: States that Jun 2026 net income is negative and that losses are persistent (a run of consecutive negative months, a negative TTM figure, or negative in most months).
results.evidence: "Net income (330,756) in Jun 2026, the 6th consecutive negative month; TTM (3,089,780)" is negative and persistent. This matches the reference net income, streak of 6 and TTM.

results.claim: Notes that cash declined: gives the Jun 2026 cash balance and a decline versus the prior month and/or six months earlier.
results.evidence: "Cash ... 713,481 at Jun 2026: down 215,543 from May 2026 and 1,871,836 from six months earlier (2,585,317)". The reference values give differences of 215,543 and 1,871,836.

results.claim: Makes any forecast or projection (cash runway, months of cash left, expected future revenue or margin, 'on track to').
results.evidence: No runway, projection or expected future figures appear. The "reviewer to confirm" notes are not forecasts.

results.claim: Asserts as fact a cause for the revenue decline that the numbers do not show (e.g. churn, pricing, lost customers, seasonality). Framing it as a question or 'reviewer to confirm' is allowed.
results.evidence: No cause is asserted for the revenue decline. Stream stoppages are framed as "for the reviewer to confirm".

results.claim: Says Jun 2026 revenue increased versus May 2026, or that Jun 2026 net income was positive.
results.evidence: Revenue is stated as "down 6.0% from May 2026", and net income is given as negative (330,756).

results.claim: States a figure for any of the reference facts that falls outside the rounding policy.
results.evidence: Every reference-fact figure is within the policy: revenue 195,898, 208,351, 196,946 and 190,556; 6.0%, 0.5% and 2.8%; GM 70.2%; net income (330,756); TTM (3,089,780); 17 of 18 negative months; 6th streak; cash 713,481 and 2,585,317.
